rationale: iter-4 search-20260619-01: ONE knob = lr 5e-4 -> 7e-4 (everything else held at iter-2's BUDGET-COMPLIANT point: lpd_iters=3, hidden=48, n_primal=5, n_dual=5, cosine, epochs=10, train_n=200, batch=1, val_chunk=1, val_n=214, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42). BUDGET MATH vs 1200s: iter-2 ran 1079.3s at ep10 -> iter-4 at the same ep10 + lr-only change is compute-identical (lr does not change FLOPs) => ~1079s=18.0min, well inside the 20-min wall. FALSIFIER: SSIM <= 0.885115 (iter-3) OR flat/down with hr still 0.000 => LPD has hit its budget-constrained ceiling on 2304-view Mayo (~0.885 SSIM, hr 0); neither epochs (wall-capped) nor lr is the lever -> projector-in-loop LPD is structurally FBP-bounded at this capacity/budget (documented ceiling), and iter-5 would need a deeper wall, not more of this budget.
